objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Log in to DVWS, find an API endpoint that runs a system command with your input (or reads files for you), and read /ctf/flag on the server.
hints: The API documentation at /api-docs lists a system information endpoint under /api/v2.
That endpoint hands a path segment to a Node.js function that spawns a shell. XXE in the SOAP service is another way to read a file.

steps.title: Find the endpoint
steps.prompt: Which API v2 endpoint returns system information by running a command? (the path segment after /api/v2/)

steps.title: Find the sink
steps.prompt: Which Node.js child_process function receives that value?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets a second command of yours run on the server?
